name: cw-i2s-sidetone
description: Generates an I2S sidetone for CW via arduino-audio-tools. VENDORED, PATCHED COPY for the Morserino-32 - not the upstream release: adds async/interruptible clip playback, selectable tone timbres, a configurable envelope, and a fix for playSPIFFSFile() cutting the end off a file. See Software/src/platformio.ini and the repository history.
